minutes.headline: Planning Board voted to send solar canopy and driveway bylaws to town meeting, and the aquifer bylaw also went forward.
minutes.summary: The board approved a site plan waiver modification for 5 Summer Street, approved two sets of minutes, and voted to prepare warrant articles for solar canopies and the large-scale solar definition, a common driveways bylaw, and an aquifer protection bylaw. Long discussion of bylaw details, followed by committee reports and a late discussion of stormwater and scenic road enforcement, with interest in a scenic road bylaw.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted to prepare warrant articles for a solar canopy accessory use and changes to the large-scale solar definition.
The board voted to put the common driveways bylaw forward to town meeting.
A motion to put the aquifer protection bylaw on the town warrant was made, but the outcome is not audible in the recording.
The board agreed to add water district notification and soften the 'approval' wording in the aquifer bylaw to 'no desire to comment'.
The board approved a site plan waiver modification for 5 Summer Street, and members expressed interest in a scenic road bylaw.
